title: Companies Act (Zakon o gospodarskih družbah, ZGD-1), 70.c člen to 70.l člen: non-financial statement, then sustainability report and tax information reports
citation: ZGD-1, Uradni list RS, št. 42/06 and later amendments; 70.c člen inserted by ZGD-1J (Uradni list RS, št. 15/17), 70.c rewritten and 70.d to 70.l inserted by ZGD-1M (Uradni list RS, št. 102/24), postponed by ZGD-1N (77/25), 70.c amended again by ZGD-1O (1270/26)
evidence: ZGD-1J (Uradni list RS, št. 15/2017 z dne 31. 3. 2017): "Za 70.b členom se doda novi 70.c člen, ki se glasi:" and the final provision "Ta zakon začne veljati petnajsti dan po objavi v Uradnem listu Republike Slovenije." The fifteenth day after 2017-03-31 is 2017-04-15, which PISRS shows as the start for ZGD-1J (veljaOd 2017-04-15). Opened https://www.uradni-list.si/glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/2017-01-0730 and https://pisrs.si/api/rezultat/zbirka/sop/2017-01-0730 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the cut from the PISRS neuradno prečiščeno besedilo (NPB) of ZGD-1 from the line '70.c člen' up to the heading of the next article that is not numbered 70 (so 70.c alone in 2017 to 2024, 70.c to 70.l from the 2024-12-18 text; the Part and heading lines in front of 71. člen are cut off). Stored versions, one per change of the cut: 2017-04-15 (NPB 15, ZGD-1J), 2024-12-18 (NPB 21, ZGD-1M), 2025-10-08 (NPB 22, ZGD-1N), 2026-02-25 (NPB 23) and 2026-07-24 (NPB 24, ZGD-1O; the file notes that the amended 70.c applies for financial years starting in 2027). NPB 16 to 20 (2019-04-20 to 2023-07-25) have the same cut as NPB 15 and are not stored. The files of NPB 1 to 20 carry no 'Datum začetka uporabe' line, so the date of NPB 15 is the veljaOd that PISRS shows for the last amendment the file lists (ZGD-1J); NPB 21 to 24 print their own date. The 2024 and later cuts are the CSRD transposition (ZGD-1M, see si-zgd-1m) as consolidated; the earlier cut is the Non-Financial Reporting Directive text. The first brief candidate, '70.c člen izjava o nefinančnem poslovanju as published', is the 2017-04-15 record. Not stored: the rest of ZGD-1 (about 880,000 characters a version) and the as-published ZGD-1J, which is not a scope instrument. Languages: Slovenian is the only language stored. Italian and Hungarian (official in the ethnically mixed municipalities) were looked for on the gazette item page, uradni-list.si/glasilo-uradni-list-rs and the PISRS act page, which serve Slovenian only. English: the PISRS list has a Companies Act file (https://pisrs.si/Prevodi/EN-2019-01-0914-2006-01-1799-npb16.doc) that reflects NPB 16, state of 2019-04-20, marked * as not the latest text; NPB 16 has the same 70.c cut as the stored 2017-04-15 record, so it would have matched the 2017-04-15 version. title: Consumer Protection Act (Zakon o varstvu potrošnikov, ZVPot-1), VIII. poglavje nepoštene poslovne prakse and, from 2026-12-12, VIII.a poglavje
citation: ZVPot-1, Uradni list RS, št. 130/22; amended by ZVPot-1A (Uradni list RS, št. 1799/26)
evidence: 249. člen (začetek veljavnosti): "Ta zakon začne veljati petnajsti dan po objavi v Uradnem listu Republike Slovenije, uporabljati pa se začne tri mesece po njegovi uveljavitvi." Published 2022-10-11 (Uradni list RS, št. 130/2022 z dne 11. 10. 2022), so in force 2022-10-26; PISRS shows veljaOd 2022-10-26. Opened https://www.uradni-list.si/glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/2022-01-3083 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the cut from 'VIII. poglavje NEPOŠTENE POSLOVNE PRAKSE' up to 'IX. poglavje': the as-published chapter (in force 2022-10-26, applies from three months later) and NPB 1 dated 2026-12-12 (its 'Datum začetka uporabe'; ZVPot-1A is in force 2026-11-13), which adds VIII.a poglavje (dodatna zaščita v zvezi s spletnimi vmesniki, rules on online interfaces) and, in VIII, the environmental-claim practices of Directive (EU) 2024/825 (for example practice 4: an environmental claim about future environmental performance without clear, objective, publicly available and verifiable commitments; the as-published chapter has no 'okoljska trditev'). The NPB date is a future date on 2026-11-02, stored as an ordinary record dated its date. PISRS shows ZVPot-1A applying from 2026-12-12; 30 days after 2026-11-13 would be 2026-12-13, and the NPB is dated 2026-12-12. The brief expected the Directive 2024/825 act to apply from 2026-09-27; Slovenia's act applies later. Not stored: the rest of ZVPot-1 (about 267,000 characters). Languages: Slovenian is the only language stored.
